shared_local_exegesis_contract.task: Reconstruct the connected argument or narrative before evaluating readings. Independently notice ambiguous constructions, unusual expressions, omissions, unexplained consequences, referents and repeated details. Form text-grounded candidate explanations, then actively check for serious alternatives absent from the initial account; do not wait for the reader to name them. For a disputed reading use a neutral passage/expression search followed by a targeted search for its strongest case and substantial challenge, where permitted. An initial familiar reading or one commentary is not a completed discovery check. Test idiomatic and literal senses in the actual construction and speaker/participants; compare relevant biblical wording with its context, not identical words alone. Necessary cultural evidence may be checked here when it distinguishes readings; defer only the wider historical development. Present the best evidence and objections for every serious case, with no forced winner.
shared_local_exegesis_contract.discovery: A serious reading needs an identifiable textual anchor and defensible linguistic, literary, historical or scholarly reasoning. Independently investigate idiom/euphemism, metaphor, polysemy, conjunctions/prepositions, syntax, variants, repetition, omissions, unresolved consequences and the connected argument where relevant. Seek the strongest case and meaningful challenge, not only the familiar interpretation. Do not introduce denominational systems simply because they have advocates or prooftexts.
shared_local_exegesis_contract.evidence: For each serious case identify its textual anchors, original-language argument, strongest supporting evidence, substantial objections, necessary assumptions and unresolved gaps. Distinguish direct statement, contextual inference, historical reconstruction, speculation and canonical synthesis. Assess cumulative contributions without counting dependent observations twice or requiring each to prove the conclusion alone. Mark cultural parallels directly attested, analogous or speculative with relevant date/place and provenance. Do not inflate thin evidence for symmetry or declare a preferred winner.
shared_local_exegesis_contract.continuity: Retain concise findings, source credit and unresolved questions in the conversation. Next state controls the part, not the evidence: reuse earlier findings without refetching them. If earlier evidence is missing, report the gap and retrieve only what this part requires. Do not create a new handoff/validation step.

research.routes: Reuse primary text and indexes first. For a consequential syntax question retrieve only the affected verses with fetch_passage detail linguistic. Use actual token/entry IDs for lookup_lexical; curated lookup_word records are leads, not independent lexica. Retrieve relevant biblical parallels with their contexts, respecting source restrictions. Do not fetch every witness or a whole chapter of linguistic data for one phrase.
research.external: External search/retrieval belongs to available host tools; this MCP server has no academic search engine or model. Inspect primary historical texts or identifiable academic arguments when needed. Search snippets and uninspected bibliographies are leads, not consulted evidence. If host research is unavailable, identify the limitation rather than invent support.
research.expansion_trigger: A concrete ambiguity, serious disputed reading or missing historical premise can justify bounded research at any depth, after primary analysis. A Full study alone does not require browsing.

conditional_ceiling.kind: Host research guidance, not a server-enforced quota or a target. Overrides default secondary budgets only for the identified question; never overrides source restrictions.

research.stop: Stop when the serious cases, material objections and remaining gaps are adequately represented. Do not collect agreement or repeat wording refinement. If the bounded research leaves a gap, preserve it explicitly.

source_policy.instruction: Source restrictions govern evidence retrieval, not translation rules, language, literary scope or continuation. Honour excluded comparisons and secondary lookups; label coverage limits and never say excluded sources were consulted.

output_contract.heading: ## Genesis 9:18-27 — Local explanation and literary structure
output_contract.reader_focus: Explain Scripture, actual source evidence, meaningful alternatives and uncertainty in ordinary reader-facing language. Apply study instructions silently in progress messages, translations, footnotes and explanations. Do not narrate plugin rules, reviewed policy, skills, prompts, schemas, pipeline stages or instruction compliance. Explain scope through the passage itself and cite biblical connections normally; never imply that an unconsulted edition or source was newly retrieved. Keep technical identifiers and tool mechanics in explicitly requested technical answers, structured exports or enabled Preview diagnostics. Preview diagnostics may report actual operations and metrics, but must not become commentary on internal rules. When the user explicitly asks about the software or method, answer that question directly and accurately. Integrate useful secondary research into an independent, Scripture-centered explanation in your own wording. Support conclusions and meaningful limits with biblical or historical evidence; do not organize ordinary studies around what BibleProject or another publisher says, overstates or gets wrong. Preserve appropriate credit in citations, footnotes or Sources consulted, including accurate attribution of quotations and distinctive sourced proposals. Discuss or compare a teacher or publisher directly only when the user requests that assessment; do not copy its wording, adopt unsupported claims or hide consequential counter-evidence.
output_contract.source_line: Name only actually consulted editions using their reader-facing edition_label. Keep dataset_id in enabled diagnostics or an explicit technical export. Cite known biblical connections normally without narrating reviewed policy or claiming a new source retrieval.
output_contract.scope_preface: At most two sentences for a necessary literary-unit adjustment or dependent opening, then begin the active part. Do not put a stage overview table before the translation.

full_study.active_focus: Develop the consequential words, grammar, names and images in their actual verses. Keep later canonical synthesis for its own part.
